title: The Angstrom Assistant
outro_say: It explains; you do the clicks. | No buy or sell calls.

steps.screen: A card: two ways in, one window
steps.say: The Angstrom Assistant answers questions about the app, and helps you turn an idea into a test. | Open it with the AI button at the top right, or beside the Lattice tabs.

steps.screen: The ✨ AI button beside the Lattice tabs
steps.say: It opens in its own window beside the app, so it never covers what you're working on.
Ask anything, in your own words.

steps.screen: Typing: I think a breakout that loses its volume often falls back. How do I check that?
steps.say: Here, an idea about breakouts that lose their volume.

steps.screen: The answer: steps in Signal Sets, and a link to the worked-example video
steps.say: It answers with the steps, using the app's own names. | It knows your saved Groups and Sets, and links the video that shows it.
Stuck on a screen? Paste a screenshot, or drop one on the window.

steps.screen: Asking what it is: the answer explains Prism Scan
steps.say: and ask what you're looking at.

steps.screen: A card: what it does and doesn't do
steps.say: It explains, and you do the clicks. | It never makes buy or sell calls. | These answers are examples; yours depend on your question.
